description: Check or apply kit updates in a Game Kit project. Dry-run by default: returns the plan (from / to version, breaking changes, migrations to run) without writing. Pass apply=true to write the new lockfile and run the migrations; range narrows the target version (e.g. ^1.2.0). Omit id to check every installed kit in one call. Call gripforge_gamekit_get on the target version to read its manifest first. 0 credits.

apply.description: true to apply the update (new lockfile + migrations). Default false = plan only.

id.description: Installed kit to update. Omit to check every installed kit.

project_id.description: Game Kit project id (gkp_…). Not a dedicated-server project (gpj_…) nor a Library item.

range.description: Semver range to satisfy (e.g. ^1.2.0, 1.x). Default: latest compatible version.

workspace_id.description: Workspace authorized by the current key. Never infer another user’s workspace.

name: gripforge_gamekit_update
title: Check or apply Game Kit updates
